_comment: One unit of competency. It exists as a file because the catalogue lists a unit — and Moodle gets a grade item for it — only once this file ships. The lessons below were READ OFF the built pages' data-criteria, not asserted here, so this cannot drift from what is actually taught.
title: Read a measurement
framework: Professor Adow TVET — Shapes and Measurements

criteria.text: Read a steel rule or tape to the nearest millimetre, naming the value rather than the nearest mark.
Take a measurement from a true end or datum, never from a damaged end or the tape's own hook when it is bent.
State the tolerance a job allows and say whether a given measurement is inside it.
criteria.evidence: Written test against a stated tolerance.

criteria.text: Hold a tape true over a long span, without sag or twist, and repeat the measurement to check it.
